item.title: Illegal Israeli settlers torch Palestinian homes once again in occupied West Bank
item.description: Overnight fires set by illegal Israeli settlers reported in Mukhamas village as Israeli forces also raid homes and detain Palestinians in nearby Hizma, northeast of occupied East Jerusalem.

item.title: Denmark FM 'more optimistic' after meeting with US over Greenland
item.description: Denmark says early talks with the US on Greenland have eased tensions, though sovereignty is not up for discussion.

item.title: 'No one owns the land': Greenland's Inuit see themselves as guardians, not owners
item.description: In a tiny fjord-side village, residents emphasise collective stewardship over private ownership, contrasting sharply with global interest in Greenland’s strategic and mineral wealth.

item.title: Iran's top diplomat heads to Türkiye for high-stakes talks on Friday
item.description: Türkiye is expected to signal opposition to military action against Iran while pushing for deeper economic ties and regional coordination

item.title: The rules-based order was always a fiction; Gaza and Greenland simply exposed it
item.description: After turning a blind eye to the Gaza genocide by Israel, the West’s anguish over Trump tearing up the rulebook is patently hypocritical.

item.title: Ethiopia suspends Tigray flights as clashes spark fears of renewed war
item.description: Tensions remain high in Tigray despite a peace agreement that ended the fighting, with several hundred thousand people still displaced.

item.title: Türkiye says Aegean warnings against Greece are issued 'indefinitely'
item.description: Turkish National Defence Ministry says its navigational warnings issued as technical objections to Greece’s activities in Aegean Sea that violate international law are not limited to two years, as claimed, but are ‘indefinite’.

item.title: Spain backs EU listing of Iran's Revolutionary Guard as 'terrorist' group, urges tough sanctions
item.description: EU must use 'all instruments' available to respond to 'repression' in Iran and support Iranian protesters, says Spanish foreign minister.

item.title: Trade between Türkiye and Nigeria expected to reach $10B after flurry of new deals
item.description: Business leaders say President Tinubu’s visit to Türkiye unlocks sweeping opportunities across defence, education and manufacturing.

item.title: Canadian Muslims mark Quebec mosque attack anniversary, warn of rising Islamophobia
item.description: Muslim community leaders say progress has stalled as divisive rhetoric and laws fuel renewed fears nearly a decade after the deadly attack.
